changes.summary: Record and query this package's own changelog using its shared library.
changes.body: Ship recorded release history and a Bun-powered cli-changelog command with text, JSON, release selection, pagination and JSON Schema output. Run bun run changelog in the repository or cli-changelog changelog after installation.

changes.summary: Extract shared changelog schemas, queries and rendering for Bun CLIs.
changes.body: Provide version selection, pagination, JSON Schema and human-readable rendering over recorded release history.

changes.summary: Consume the application's Zod installation through a peer dependency.
